data.name: Pizzah!
data.detailed_description:
Order up!

You and your friends sail to an island on a ferry full of hungry customers who want Pizza! The island is home to a variety of creatures which you'll need to grind up into ingredients needed to make the most amazing pizzas! Just make sure to be careful... some creatures that lurk in the dark are more interested in doing the hunting!

Make use of quality plastic tools!

When bare hands aren't enough, buy some of the finest second-hand tools! While they were once at home in a kid's toy toolbox, they are now even more valuable in your hands! Use traps, lures, nets, and more to capture or evade all manner of creature!

Discover a diverse array of creatures!

Across the different biomes of the island, there are a number of unique creatures to find, all with their own behaviors, responses to threats, and methods of catching! 

Collaborate with your friends!
Transport your friends around in the restaurant's van, communicate with proximity voice chat, and work together to corral fleeing creatures! Or just be a nuisance. Up to you.
